player_prompt.intro:
Uri Mwari {player_id} mumhango unorukwa {num_rounds} wa IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Mumhango wenyu, tatenga nambari pakati pe {min_guess} na {max_guess}.
Mushure mekutatenda kwenyu, chibato ndicho (2/3)x(muchato wa makutatenda ose),
na mwari asina makutatenda anozama kuchibato huchina mwendo uyo.
Linganisa na chitatendo chako kwenye muundo '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Fomati isiriyo; tapota tumira fungidziro yako se [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Fungidzira kunofanira kuva pakati pe {min_guess} ne {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Mwari 0 akatenga {guess0}; Mwari 1 akatenga {guess1}. Kwa hivyo Lengo ni: {target}.
